output.summary: The 98% on-time figure is largely produced by the KPI definition. Revisions rose 5x only after the bonus took effect, at each center on its own start date (Pell Junction lagged until July). Revisions shifted to Operational-Capacity, were entered late, and mostly went unnotified. Brightwell's receiving log shows 81% against 87% a year earlier, and lateness complaints rose 35% while damage and billing complaints stayed flat. RouteWise cannot explain the jump, since Northgate's gain came before its October go-live. Driver shortage is plausible but unadjusted. Suspend the claim, recompute against original dates, and re-base the incentive. Do not raise the bonus or hire drivers until Q1 and Q2 are done.
